Two contexts. One action-conditioned predictor.
The hypothesis

Appearance changes and dynamics changes need different evidence.

01
Observation context

Use past visual features to calibrate what the model sees.

02
Dynamics context

Use calibrated history and executed actions to predict what happens next.

Canonical renders are training targets. At deployment, context comes from real past observations and actions.

A controlled test

Hold out a combination, not an entire factor.

Read the comparison and planning protocol

Aligned comparisons use framewise calibration, a shared context, and paired or unpaired factorized contexts. Plain fine-tuning remains an unaligned diagnostic. These controlled simulator tests do not reproduce the original LeWM benchmark unchanged.

Main model planning uses 300 CEM candidates, 30 iterations, and 30 elites for every method. The 50-step interaction budget includes 10 support steps. Success during support is recorded separately. The historical lower-budget development check is a diagnostic, not evidence of a factorization benefit.
